title: SS28 Men's Technical Ease
summary: Tailoring that moves: technical blazers, ultrastretch trousers and tailored baselayers for hot cities.
research_period: SS28 previews published November 2025 to November 2026; SS27 runway record

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Long-range projection. SS28 fabric fairs open with Première Vision Paris on 26-28 January 2027, and the shows run from June to October 2027. This report projects from the first SS28 forecaster and fair previews, the SS27 runways and long-term market and regulatory drivers. Forecut will update it after the fairs and again after the shows.

sections.heading: The story
sections.body: Future Snoops expects performance, everyday and occasion wear to merge, with "technical blazers" and "tailored baselayers" <sup>[1]</sup>. SS27 menswear was shaped by heat <sup>[2]</sup>.

sections.heading: Colours
sections.body: Inky blue, khaki green, bleached linen.

sections.heading: Silhouettes
sections.body:
- Technical blazer.
- Ultrastretch trouser.
- Baselayer tee.

sections.heading: Fabrics
sections.body: Ultrastretch woven, hyperlight nylon, cooling jersey.
